market_question: Will Eleni Kounalakis win the California Governor Election in 2026?
reasoning: Eleni Kounalakis is the sitting Lieutenant Governor of California, a Democrat in a state where the Democratic nominee is overwhelmingly favored to win the 2026 open-seat gubernatorial race. Although the primary will be crowded, her statewide name recognition and political experience give her at least a 5–10% chance. The market’s implied 0.2% is far too pessimistic.
evidence_points: Incumbent Lt. Governor of California, elected 2018 and re-elected 2022
Open seat in 2026 due to Newsom’s term limit, making the Democratic primary highly competitive
Historical precedent: last three Democratic Lt. Governors to run (Gray Davis, Gavin Newsom) all advanced to become Governor
sources_consulted: California election history (Secretary of State records)
News coverage of early 2026 gubernatorial field (Politico, Los Angeles Times, SF Chronicle)
